item.tib: me ston rnal 'byor nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi skyes rabs gsol 'debs thar pa'i skas lam
item.coloph: bdag cag gang zag nyon mongs lus can gyis/ rig pa'i ye shes nyi zla zang thal la/ dpag med nyon shes sgrib pa'i sprin gyi (gyis bsgribs)/ lji ba bzhi yi dkor gyi mun pas 'thib/ nying 'khrul rtog pa'i snang ba rab rib la/ las ngan bag chags sa gzhi'i rdul grangs tsam/ bzang po'i bag chags nam mkha'i sbrang char tsam/ de de bzhin bzang ngan skye lus ni/ ming gi brjod bya grangs med grangs 'das shing / snga phyi skyes rabs bstod 'os ma gsal yang / sa gsum rig 'dzin bde chen gling pa sogs/ mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rnams kyi bka' lung dang / srid gsum sgron me sprul sku rnams bzhi sogs/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gsang lung tha dag la/ zur tsam gsal ba rnams la gtsor bzhag nas/ me ston gang de'i (des) mthong grol khrod du sbyar/ rang kheng nyes tshogs bla ma lha la bshags/ rnam dkar dge tshogs mtha' yas 'gro la bsngo/ mngon mtho nges legs mngon byang sar 'god shog/
